name: streetlives-api
description: The Streetlives backend providing the API

scripts.build-zip: npm run build && (cd dist; zip -r ../`date +%Y-%m-%d`-streetlives-api-`git rev-parse --short HEAD`.zip *)
scripts.invoke-lambda: aws lambda invoke --function-name $npm_package_config_functionName --region $npm_package_config_region --payload file://api-gateway-event.json lambda-invoke-response.json && cat lambda-invoke-response.json
scripts.package: cp -r node_modules dist/; cd dist && zip -r ../dist.zip *
scripts.deploy:dev: aws s3 cp dist.zip s3://$npm_package_config_s3BucketName && aws lambda update-function-code --function-name $npm_package_config_functionName --s3-bucket $npm_package_config_s3BucketName --s3-key dist.zip --publish --query FunctionArn --output text && aws s3 rm s3://$npm_package_config_s3BucketName/dist.zip
scripts.deploy:prod: aws s3 cp dist.zip s3://$npm_package_config_s3BucketName && aws lambda update-function-code --function-name $npm_package_config_prodFunctionName --s3-bucket $npm_package_config_s3BucketName --s3-key dist.zip --publish --query FunctionArn --output text && aws s3 rm s3://$npm_package_config_s3BucketName/dist.zip
scripts.package-deploy:dev: npm run clean && npm run build && npm run package && npm run deploy:dev
scripts.package-deploy:prod: npm run clean && npm run build && npm run package && npm run deploy:prod
scripts.setup: npm install && (aws s3api get-bucket-location --bucket $npm_package_config_s3BucketName --region $npm_package_config_region || npm run create-bucket) && npm run package-deploy
